extracted.intended_audience: public information officers (PIOs), institutional press officers, and working reporters who use EurekAlert! to submit or access science news releases
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and rules for submitting, accessing, and redistributing news releases via the EurekAlert! platform, including contributor eligibility, embargo rules, fees, account requirements, and technical/administrative requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributor eligibility (who may contribute)
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! only accepts content contributions from public information officers (PIOs) at eligible organizations that conduct, publish, or fund scientific research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PIOs wishing to submit releases must meet EurekAlert!'s eligibility criteria, complete the online application form, and pay a submission fee. Institutions must pay a fee to submit news releases to EurekAlert!. Payment of submission fees does not guarantee acceptance of news releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: News release eligibility (what releases are accepted)
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases must meet EurekAlert!'s longstanding eligibility guidelines in order to be accepted and hosted on the website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guidelines (linked at www.eurekalert.org/releaseguidelines) govern acceptance. Examples of acceptable content described in the FAQ include research findings recently published in peer-reviewed journals, timely information related to business/innovation/societal aspects of science, and details of grants, awards, books, and scientific meetings. Payment does not guarantee acceptance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission fees and payment options
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutions must pay submission fees; submission fees depend on the type of institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PIOs may pay a per-release submission fee or an annual fee that covers eligible submissions. Consult the fee schedules for news releases and sponsored content for details. For pricing or to place an order, contact EurekAlert! business staff. Note: payment does not guarantee acceptance of news releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo definition and permitted use
rubrics_metrics.description: A news embargo is a prohibition against making public, in any way, certain information before a specific date/time, typically set by a journal publisher and coinciding with article publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalists who agree to embargoes are offered related materials in advance (manuscript, news releases, multimedia, author interviews, third-party commentaries) to help produce accurate stories. PIOs may designate an embargo date/time when submitting a news release. All reporter- and PIO-registrants must digitally sign an embargo agreement prior to obtaining an account on EurekAlert!.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who sets and whose embargoes EurekAlert! enforces
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! only recognizes or enforces embargo guidelines set by legitimate content owners, such as journal publishers and scientific meeting organizers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EurekAlert! provides reporter-registrants access to embargoed content submitted by journal publishers and research institutions, and will enforce embargo restrictions that originate with legitimate content owners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo agreement requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All reporter- and PIO-registrants must digitally sign an embargo agreement prior to obtaining an account on EurekAlert!.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Digital signature on the embargo agreement is a required step in both reporter and PIO account registration; reporters and PIOs must comply with the terms before accessing embargoed materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporter account eligibility and features
rubrics_metrics.description: Working reporters who meet EurekAlert!'s eligibility criteria may apply for free access to the reporter-only section, which hosts embargoed news releases and press materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is no cost to register as a reporter, but applicants must meet eligibility criteria and sign the embargo agreement. Upon approval reporters receive a username and temporary password, are encouraged to change it immediately, and gain access to customizable daily e-mail alerts and embargo change notifications. Individual accounts are required (no sharing).

rubrics_metrics.name: PIO account eligibility and features
rubrics_metrics.description: Working PIOs who meet EurekAlert!'s eligibility criteria may apply for free access to the PIO-only section and purchase access to submit news releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PIO registrants must meet eligibility criteria, sign the embargo agreement, and may register at no cost; submitting content requires paying submission fees. PIO-only features include advance notifications of forthcoming journal articles, an online discussion forum, PIO seminars/webinars, and customizable alerts. Individual accounts are required (no sharing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account sharing prohibition and per-person registration
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! does not allow the sharing of reporter or PIO accounts; every individual who requires access must register and digitally sign the embargo agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is no limit to the number of eligible reporters or PIOs from an outlet/organization who can register, but each must have their own account. Individual accounts provide individualized services such as customizable alerts and forum access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission processing times and office hours
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert!'s office hours are 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday (excluding holidays).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions or inquiries received during office hours will be processed the same day; submissions received outside office hours will be processed on the next business day. Staff typically responds to account applications within one business day and may request additional information or clarification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Password complexity requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Passwords must meet specific complexity rules when set or changed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Passwords must: be 6 characters or longer; include one UPPER CASE character; include one lower case character; include one number; include one special character. If assistance is needed, contact webmaster.

rubrics_metrics.name: Redistribution and reuse policy
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! content is intended to support editorially independent news coverage and public consumption, but EurekAlert! requests users refrain from wholesale duplication or content aggregation without permission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AAAS and EurekAlert! encourage broad communication of scientific research but reserve the right to determine appropriate uses of EurekAlert! content at their sole discretion. Do not duplicate EurekAlert! content on other websites in a wholesale or 'content aggregation' fashion without expressed permission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription policy and institution definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Under the subscription policy, an institution is defined as one entity supported by its own public relations function; affiliated organizations may require separate subscriptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An institution representing multiple organizations may require multiple subscriptions (e.g., a medical school or hospital affiliated with a university but supported by a separate PR team must pay individually). A university and its affiliated publisher are considered separate entities. EurekAlert! reserves the right to adjust pricing or terms if usage extends to affiliated entities, partners, or third parties; contact business staff to discuss needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsored content and banner promotion rules
rubrics_metrics.description: PIO-registrants may promote evergreen science-related content through the Sponsored Content program which circulates web banners across the EurekAlert! site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For details on sponsored content and how to purchase banners, PIOs should consult the Sponsored Content page or e-mail sponsoredcontent[AT]eurekalert[DOT]org. A fee is required for sponsored content; news releases must still meet eligibility guidelines to be accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of content EurekAlert! hosts
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! hosts news releases produced by universities, journal publishers, medical centers, government agencies, corporations, and other organizations engaged in scientific research, as well as online newsrooms/microsites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hosted releases often describe peer-reviewed research findings, timely business/innovation/societal science information, and announcements about grants, awards, books, and meetings. Microsites aggregate releases published by or relevant to particular organizations or meetings.
